requirements.text: Patients should be able to view available appointment times and book, cancel, or change appointments with a simple interface that minimizes confusion.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions by selecting the medication and confirming their personal details, with a streamlined process that only requires essential information.
Patients should be able to view their test results only after a doctor has reviewed them, with a secure process in place to ensure this.
The portal should include a notification system to alert patients via email or messaging when their test results are ready to view.
The portal must adhere to regulations regarding patient data privacy and security, ensuring that all information is kept safe and compliant with applicable laws.
